definitionZh: 基线转换的CSS属性相对于其母文本内容要素的主导基线调整了文本要素的主导基线。 变换的元素可能是下标或上标. 如果属性存在,则值将超过元素的属性.
sourceDefinition: The baseline-shift CSS property repositions the dominant-baseline of a text element relative to the dominant-baseline of its parent text content element. The shifted element might be a sub- or superscript. If the property is present, the value overrides the element's attribute.
